task_description.overview: Detect seismic onsets using a delayed STA/LTA algorithm with improved stability.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Using seismic samples in {waveform_data_path}, compute delayed STA/LTA with STA={STA_seconds}s and LTA={LTA_seconds}s. Detect triggers crossing {on_threshold} and {off_threshold}. Plot a figure to show the waveform, the delayed sta/lta caculated result, and the finally picked onset and offset times. Save the 1D array trigger_cft series to {trigger_cft} and the plot to {trigger_plot}.
